summary: First-finish smoke test for DH Salon backend + frontend. All 21 targeted backend endpoints and 9 critical frontend flows passed. Admin dashboard, services grid + category filter, add-to-cart, cart total, checkout page, memberships subscribe buttons, and Stripe checkout session creation all work.
passed: GET /api/ returns {message: 'DH Salon API'}
GET /api/services returns 8 seeded services (auto-seed working)
GET /api/services/categories returns 7 categories
GET /api/services/{id} returns service details incl. reviews array
POST /api/auth/register (random email) returns token + user (role=customer)
POST /api/auth/login (admin@dhsalon.com/Admin@123) returns token, role=admin
GET /api/auth/me returns user without password
POST /api/addresses + GET /api/addresses works with saved address
POST /api/cart/add + GET /api/cart returns items with correct total ($89)
POST /api/reviews with rating 5 accepted and returns review doc
GET /api/memberships/plans returns basic, advanced, premium
POST /api/payments/checkout kind=cart returns checkout_url + session_id, transaction stored
POST /api/payments/checkout kind=membership plan_id=advanced returns checkout_url
GET /api/payments/status/{sid} returns status=initiated, payment_status=pending for unpaid
GET /api/admin/stats returns {users, services, bookings, revenue} for admin
GET /api/admin/users and /api/admin/bookings return 200 for admin
Non-admin user hitting /api/admin/stats returns 403
Home page loads with hero-book-btn, nav-services, nav-memberships
/services shows 8 service cards; cat-Facial filter reduces to 2 cards
Service detail page loads and shows add-to-cart-btn
Admin login via UI redirects to /admin and shows 'Admin' name in header
/memberships shows subscribe-basic/advanced/premium buttons
/admin dashboard shows stats (2 members, 8 services) and tabs (bookings/services/users)
/cart shows cart-total ($89.00) and proceed-checkout-btn after add
/checkout renders slot-select-trigger and pay-now-btn
notes: Did not complete Stripe hosted checkout as instructed. Session creation + status polling verified only.
